NOT Kobo in North Wollo, confirmed twice over. (1) Date: the four other 11 Oct 2017 samples are at 7.68 to 8.54 N; Kobo is 12.15 N, a 450 km jump against an Ethiopian observed maximum same-date spread of 95 km. (2) Sample ID, which is independent of the date field: Ada21 IDs run in collection order and 17.0504 sits between 17.0503 Weliso Kora (8.54 N 37.98 E) and 17.0505 Gurage Zone (8.22 N 38.43 E), 55 km apart. (3) The table names places general to specific, so this is woreda 'Ilu' plus kebele 'kobo'; Kobo would be written 'Kobo Ilu'. Ilu woreda near Addis fits all three but is not in OSM under any query tried.

Gut Gommershoven is a farm ESTATE at Rath, Bedburg, Rhein-Erft-Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, not a settlement, which is why no German place list has it. GeoNames feature 2919134 (via mindat) gives 51.02002 N 6.62905 E and OSM gives 51.01969 N 6.62850 E as a landuse polygon, agreeing to 40 m. Bare 'Gommershoven' returns the estate ROAD and is correctly rejected by the class guard; the 'Gut' prefix is what finds it. Recurs in both PRJEB15280 and PRJEB39201.
